title: Endava's scaled engineering comes with little public-sector footprint
content:
Endava is recorded as scaled engineering with little public-sector footprint, and that pairing is the whole basis for its priority 9 filing. Scale on its own is a soft negative in this screen; the decisive part is the absence of the public-sector footprint that the thesis leans on, because that is where sovereign deployment and auditable decision records are already funded questions rather than arguments to be made from scratch.

What the record does not contain is any platform assessment: the tool column reads not researched. So the exclusion rests entirely on positioning, and none of the criteria that actually decide the interesting cases — which workflow or content platform is carried, whether the app-layer slot is occupied, whether the firm's portfolio is open-source-native — were ever applied here.

That makes this a low-confidence exclusion rather than a settled one. If the public-sector read were ever revised, the row would need a fresh screen from the stack up rather than a re-ranking, since there is no platform evidence on file to re-weigh.
